meta.name: seo-competitor-pages
meta.description: Generate SEO-optimized "X vs Y" comparison and "alternatives to X" landing pages targeting comparative-intent keywords. Pulls competitor data, comparative-intent SERPs, and existing comparison pages to produce a balanced, structured page draft with feature matrix, schema, and conversion blocks. Distinct from `seo-agency-landing-page` (top-of-funnel demand-gen). Use when the user asks for "comparison page", "vs page", "alternatives page", "X vs Y", "alternative to X", or "competitor comparison page".
